values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground is managed from mid-May through mid-September, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions, but can generally be reached between mid-May to mid-November.'
Drinking water: the page contradicts itself ('Amenities include potable water' in the description, 'Potable water is not available at this site.' under Water). Boat ramp developed for small boats.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/spar-lake-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; description and Water section), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai NF (Three Rivers RD), at the north end of Spar Lake, 2.5 mi east of Troy then 17 mi south on Lake Creek Road #384; tables and fire rings, small-boat ramp. Since February 2026 FS Road 384 is closed to motor vehicles from the Whoopie Creek bridge (~MP 18) to its end, past the campground (flood damage; order through Feb 2028). --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated Aug 28, 2026): confirmed $12, 13 sites (1 host), vault toilets; added the 50% Senior/Access discount, 28-ft site length ('most sites'), managed mid-May-mid-Sept but open all year (year_round with note). Drinking water left as is: the page both lists and denies it. Not stated: FCFS/reservations (derived left). Note trimmed of restated values; road-closure caveat added.
flags: Road closure: Kootenai NF order 01-14-04-26-04 (Feb 6, 2026 - Feb 5, 2028) closes FS Road #384 to motor vehicles from the Whoopie Creek bridge (~MP 18) to its terminus. The order's map shows the closure starting south-west of the lake's north end, i.e. beyond the campground, so the campground should still be drivable; worth a call to confirm (Three Rivers RD 406-295-4693).
